findings.oracle: Replaced with test_no_config_writes_logs_under_cwd_logs: drives real setup_logging, emits real structlog record, asserts intellicrack.log file exists under cwd/logs and contains JSON record with event==_UNIQUE_EVENT and probe==True.

Replaced with test_configured_logs_directory_receives_real_logs: saves real Config with logs_directory=target_logs, drives setup_logging, asserts log file appears in target_logs and NOT under cwd/logs, and the JSON record contains logger==intellicrack.audit6.

Replaced with test_state_after_setup_logging_drives_real_log_files: first setup_logging records target dir in _logger_state; second setup_logging (no explicit log_dir) must write real log to same dir; asserts log file exists and probe record JSON contains probe==True.

Replaced with test_explicit_log_dir_is_written_and_recorded: drives setup_logging with explicit target, asserts log file exists with JSON event record, and asserts _logger_state.configured_log_dir == target.

Replaced with test_result_full_structure_for_42: asserts the entire result dict equals a hand-computed expected dict of all 14 keys with independently-known IEEE-754 and base-representation constants for value 42.
